title: manager plan · Advance to researcher with a revised, feasible benchmarking task targe
summary: Advance to researcher with a revised, feasible benchmarking task targeting specific existing datasets.
body: The previous plan failed because no sources exist comparing dynamic vs. static memory under identical fixed token budgets. Forcing 4 sources on this impossible constraint violates the stopping rule and yields no evidence. We must pivot to a feasible empirical question: compare dynamic consolidation against a simple baseline (e.g., append-only) using a specific, reproducible benchmark that measures task success and token usage. We will target LongMemEval and MemoryAgentBench, inspecting 4 sources that provide the necessary controlled comparisons or clear failure modes. This ensures we gather usable data within the 4-source limit without inventing evidence.
